description.value: A MICHELIN Guide recommended Italian restaurant inspired by the Friuli region of northern Italy, located inside the Hyatt Vancouver Downtown Alberni. Fresh pasta is made in-house daily and the seasonal menu highlights local BC ingredients, including eggs from the restaurant group's own farm in Abbotsford. Part of a well-known Vancouver restaurant group that also operates Ask For Luigi, Di Beppe, and several other establishments.
